caption:
A Bay of Bengal depression is risking a turn into a severe cyclonic storm. 🌪️

A depression over the east-central and southeastern Bay of Bengal may intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm, according to the Bangladesh Meteorological Department.

The system is expected to move southwards and intensify into a deep depression on Sunday before gradually shifting west-northwestwards.

The storm is forecast to cross India's Andhra coast around October 28.

As of 6am Sunday, the depression was located 785km south of Chattogram port, 700km south of Cox's Bazar port, 820km south of Mongla port, and 760km south of Payra port.

Wind speeds within 44km of the centre were recorded at 40 kmph, with gusts or squalls reaching up to 50 kmph, causing rough seas near the centre.

Local cautionary signal No. 1 has been hoisted at Chattogram, Cox's Bazar, Mongla, and Payra ports.

Fishing boats and trawlers in the northern Bay of Bengal have been advised to stay close to the coast and navigate with caution until further notice.

headline: Madrasa teacher arrested for raping 9-year-old student in Lakshmipur
summary: A teacher at a Hafezia Madrasa in Chandraganj was detained by police after the victim's mother filed a complaint alleging long-term abuse.
details: Police have arrested a madrasa teacher named Md. Ibrahim in Chandraganj, Lakshmipur, following allegations of raping a 9-year-old residential student.
The arrest took place on Saturday afternoon at the madrasa premises after a formal complaint was lodged by the mother of the victim.
According to the victim's mother, Md. Ibrahim and another individual had been raping the child for a long period of time.
The mother has demanded exemplary punishment for the perpetrators if the allegations are proven true during the investigation.
Chandraganj Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Abdur Rob confirmed that a case has been filed and the arrested teacher has been sent to court.
Police are currently conducting efforts to arrest the second accused individual who remains at large.
caption:
A 9-year-old residential student was allegedly raped for a long period by a teacher and another man in Lakshmipur.

Police have arrested a madrasa teacher named Md. Ibrahim in Chandraganj, Lakshmipur, following allegations of raping a 9-year-old residential student.

The arrest took place on Saturday afternoon at the madrasa premises after a formal complaint was lodged by the mother of the victim.

According to the victim's mother, Md. Ibrahim and another individual had been raping the child for a long period of time.

The mother has demanded exemplary punishment for the perpetrators if the allegations are proven true during the investigation.

Chandraganj Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Abdur Rob confirmed that a case has been filed and the arrested teacher has been sent to court.

Police are currently conducting efforts to arrest the second accused individual who remains at large.
